cohort: The study included 31 neonates with bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD cases) and 31 non-BPD neonates (controls) admitted between January 2017 and January 2018.
finding: MIF was overexpressed and PLTP was under-expressed in the serum and BALF of BPD neonates compared to controls, with these levels showing diagnostic significance for BPD.
